Problem Statement:
Assume you are john. John has one younger sister 'jenny'. He wants to gift her some toys. He has a price list of toys and he has some amount on hand. Your task is to tell him how many toys john will be able to buy for her sister
input_spec: First line contains two integer 'n' and 'k' ,n denotes the number of toys and k denotes total money he has.Next line contains n space separated integers denoting price of each toy
output_spec: Print the max number of toys he can buy.
